Primary Responsibilities: Architect, design, engineer, and implement secure hybrid cloud solutions utilizing Microsoft Azure and AWS. The successful candidate will serve as a senior technical contributor responsible for architecting, engineering, implementing, and sustaining secure hybrid cloud solutions across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Clearance: Must have Active DoD Top Secret security clearance with eligibility for Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) access.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This position requires both strategic cloud architecture expertise and hands-on engineering experience in designing and deploying modern cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, and security solutions within highly secure enterprise environments. Design and deploy greenfield cloud environments supporting Department of Defense mission requirements. Support system accreditation activities and ensure compliance with DoD security policies, NIST guidance, and Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline with 12+ years of relevant experience. Minimum of five (5) years of experience architecting and implementing enterprise cloud solutions. Hands-on experience implementing and administering: * Microsoft Intune* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint* Microsoft Purview* A
